text: {"lessons":["My trades did not reliably improve results: after buying more Stock E, its price fell sharply, so I should not assume a purchase will quickly pay off.","Selling Stocks C and D after strong gains and adding to other holdings changed my exposure; I should make such trades based on portfolio balance and a clear plan, not just recent gains.","A nearly unchanged account value over a period says little about whether my strategy is sound; I should avoid reacting to short-term fluctuations and keep risk diversified."]}
